title: Air VFR HUD
description: Data payload for msg_type 'vfrhud'. Carries MAVLink VFR_HUD message fields used to populate a pilot's heads-up display.

airspeed_ms.description: Current indicated airspeed in metres per second.

groundspeed_ms.description: Current ground speed in metres per second.

heading_deg.description: Current heading in degrees (0-360, clockwise from North).

throttle_pct.description: Current throttle setting as a percentage (0-100%).

alt_m.description: Current altitude in metres above mean sea level.

climb_ms.description: Current climb rate in metres per second (positive = climbing).
